units.source_text: 这老僧奉赠公子金刚杵[\[16\]](#part1334.html#m16)一具，以为护身之用。

en.t: This old monk presented the young lord with a vajra pestle[16] to serve as a protective charm.

units.source_text: 僧都则奉赠公子金刚子数珠[\[17\]](#part1334.html#m17)一串，

en.t: The bishop, for his part, presented the young lord with a string of bodhi-seed prayer beads[17],

units.source_text: 是圣德太子[\[18\]](#part1334.html#m18)从百济取得的，

en.t: which Prince Shotoku[18] had obtained from Baekje,

units.source_text: 装在一只也是从百济来的中国式盒子里，

en.t: and they were kept in a Chinese-style box that had also come from Baekje,

units.source_text: 盒子外面套着镂空花纹袋子，结着五叶松枝。

en.t: with an openwork patterned pouch drawn over the outside of the box and a branch of five-needle pine tied to it.

units.source_text: 又奉赠种种药品，装在绀色琉璃瓶中，结着藤花枝和樱花枝。

en.t: He also presented various medicines, placed in dark blue glass bottles and adorned with branches of wisteria and cherry blossoms.

units.source_text: 这些都是与僧都身份相称的礼物。

en.t: All of these were gifts befitting the bishop's station.
